title: SRAM: what kind of bike frame is compatible with Rival XPLR AXS?
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Gravel frames with a UDH-capable dropout interface are compatible with Rival XPLR AXS. Chainstays down to 415 mm are endorsed with a 47.5 mm chainline; chainstays between 405 and 415 mm can be used with a standard road crankset at a 45 mm chainline; rear-suspension designs whose chainstay length varies are not supported. These figures are not assigned to any catalog frame without exact compatibility evidence.
